run_projected_replicator_dynamics: run the projected replicator dynamics algorithm on a list of payoff tensors to compute equilibrium strategies
compute_partial_multi_dot: compute expected returns for each action of a player given other players' strategies using generalized dot product
project_simplex: project a strategy vector onto the gamma-simplex using exact L2-norm projection
approx_simplex_projection: approximately project a strategy vector onto the gamma-simplex by clipping and renormalizing
run_prd_step: perform one step of projected replicator dynamics updating all player strategies given payoff tensors
